full_prompt_en: A square, richly textured digital collage presents an extreme close view of a woman's face emerging from dense clusters of small flowers. A narrow white border encloses the image. Deep navy and cobalt blue blooms crowd the left side and upper left, while intense orange, yellow, coral, pink, and turquoise blossoms gather across the upper right and descend beside the cheek. The face fills almost the entire frame and turns slightly toward the left, so the visible nose extends into the blue flowers and the chin approaches the lower edge. One large turquoise-blue eye near the upper center looks upward and toward the right, framed by a dark eyebrow, long lashes, and warm reddish shadow along the lid. The other eye is outside the crop or hidden by the floral mass. Pale skin is built from countless tiny patches of peach, cream, blush pink, mint, and powder blue, giving the cheek and forehead a flecked, mosaic-like surface rather than a single smooth tone. The bridge and tip of the nose are softly modeled in pink and warm gray. Full muted rose lips remain distinct at the lower left-center, with a bright highlight along the lower lip and a darker crease between them. At the right edge, layered blossoms overlap the cheek, temple, and jaw; their petals are more clearly shaped than the smaller color fragments scattered across the skin. The deep blue floral region at left presses closely against the profile, making the face appear partly embedded in the surrounding pattern. Light is broad and frontal, keeping the eye and central facial planes luminous while dark blue gaps between blossoms supply the strongest shadows. The image mixes realistic anatomy and glossy eye detail with dense painterly fragments and crisp petal edges. No words or lettering appear within the picture. The overall composition is immersive and almost wall-to-wall, using a cool blue enclosure and hot floral accents to create a vivid, dreamlike surface.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、肌理丰富的数字拼贴呈现一位女子的面部极近特写，她从密集的小花簇中浮现。图像由一道窄白边围住。深海军蓝和钴蓝色花朵挤满左侧及左上，强烈的橙、黄、珊瑚、粉红和青绿色花朵聚于右上，并沿面颊向下延伸。面部几乎填满画幅，略向左侧转动，可见鼻子伸入蓝色花丛，下巴逼近下缘。上部中央附近，一只大的青蓝色眼睛向上并偏右望去，深色眉毛、长睫毛和眼睑附近暖红色阴影勾勒其周围。另一只眼睛落在裁切外，或被花团遮住。浅色皮肤由无数桃色、奶油色、淡粉、薄荷色和粉蓝色小色片构成，让面颊与额头具有斑点状、近似马赛克的表面，而非单一平滑色调。鼻梁与鼻尖由粉色和暖灰柔和塑形。饱满的低调玫瑰色嘴唇在左下中央保持清晰，下唇沿线有亮光，双唇间有更深的缝隙。右缘层叠花朵遮住面颊、太阳穴与下颌的一部分；相比皮肤上散落的更小色块，花瓣形状更加明确。左侧深蓝花区紧贴侧面轮廓，使脸仿佛部分嵌入周围图案。光宽阔而正面，让眼睛和中央面部色面保持明亮，花朵之间的深蓝空隙则提供最强阴影。图像把写实的解剖结构及光亮眼部细节与密集绘画碎片、清晰花瓣边缘结合。画中没有文字或字母。整体构图具有沉浸感，色彩几乎铺满画面，以冷蓝包围和炽热花色重音营造鲜明的梦境表面。
style_prompt_en: The digital collage fuses precisely modeled volume with dense, petal-like fragments of color. Large cobalt and navy areas press against clusters of saturated orange, coral, pink, yellow, and turquoise, making warm-cool contrast the main organizing force. Small irregular marks vary between opaque, raised-looking pieces and translucent flecks; they accumulate in thick bands and scatter more thinly across smoother central passages. Selected focal details remain glossy and sharply defined, while surrounding edges break into a crowded mosaic of overlapping shapes. Broad frontal illumination preserves luminous midtones despite the high color density, and deep blue recesses provide shadow without muting the vibrant accents. The composition fills nearly every corner, yet a clear tonal and detail hierarchy stops the texture from becoming uniform. The overall effect is exuberant and dreamlike, balancing realistic dimensionality with a tactile, ornamental surface.
style_prompt_zh: 数字拼贴把精确塑造的体积与密集、花瓣般的色彩碎片融合。大块钴蓝和海军蓝紧贴高饱和橙色、珊瑚色、粉红、黄色及青绿色聚簇，让冷暖反差成为主要组织力量。小而不规则的痕迹有些像不透明、略微凸起的片块，有些如半透明斑点；它们在厚密色带里堆积，在较平滑的中央区域则稀疏散开。少数视觉焦点细节保持光亮而清晰，周围边缘却分解为拥挤、重叠的马赛克形态。宽阔的正面照明在高度密集的色彩中保留明亮中间调，深蓝凹处提供阴影，却不压低鲜艳重音。构图几乎填满每个角落，明确的明度和细节层级仍让肌理不至于变得均匀。整体效果热烈而如梦，以写实体积感平衡可触的装饰表面。
theme_en: A close face emerging from vivid blue and orange blossoms
theme_zh: 从鲜蓝与橙色花丛中浮现的面部特写
name: Jeannette Guichard-Bunel
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
